candidate_scope: Gate, Up and Down only; aligned Q4, exactly two rows on Darwin/arm64; wide or unsupported calls use the original projection. Preserve the worker ranges, four FP32 lanes, block scales, two-stage reduction, full Up store and SwiGLU placement.
parity: The two reference labels run the ordinary model method. The two SIMD labels run a staged copy of that method with three FFN calls changed. Compare the complete seven-step outputs, KV, token IDs, positions and workspace from the same private KV tails, and compare with the prior ordinary-toolchain profile on the same corpus prefixes. Check SIMD dispatch counts per call. All four labels share a process, compiler, executor and model.
advancement: Require complete exactness, stable reference/reference and SIMD/SIMD controls, preserved one-session performance (all SIMD labels fall back), both two-session prefix medians at least 5% shorter with at least 7 wins each, and SIMD-first and reference-first medians both below one. This is a live diagnostic, not an ordinary build comparison or default adoption.
